Definition: to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to beat, stamp, beat out, spread out, stretch; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to stamp, beat out; 1a2) one who beats out (participle); 1b) (Piel) to overlay, beat out (for plating); 1c) (Pual) beaten out (participle); 1d) (Hiphil) to make a spreading (of clouds)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
